end.summary:
Defined food miles as the distance food travels from where it is grown to where it is eaten.
Identified that local spinach has fewer food miles than apples transported from Shimla.
Named fuel use as one impact of transporting food.
Suggested that imported food is better or healthier; this misconception remained at the end.
Teach-back was not passed; visual examples requested but were not available.
end.parentNote: Rohan practised comparing food miles using spinach and apples and identified fuel use as an impact of transport. They explained the distance part clearly, but continued to link imported food with being healthier or better; this was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, compare two foods and discuss both their travel distance and nutrition separately, using a food label or trusted source.
